sources.entry: Launchy - An app launcher and switcher that utilizes a radial menu.

summary.name: Launchy
summary.one_liner: Launchy is a free macOS app launcher and app switcher that opens apps, files, and folders from a customizable radial menu.
use_cases: Launching frequently used apps without digging through the Dock
Switching between running apps faster than Command-Tab
Opening files and folders from the keyboard
Organizing a custom set of apps in a radial menu
summary.what_it_does: Launchy shows a radial menu, centered on screen or at the mouse cursor, for launching apps, files, and folders. Users can add apps by drag-and-drop, arrange them, and set per-app launch behaviors such as hiding Launchy or other apps. Navigation works with arrow keys or A–Z letter keys. It has two modes, user-defined and running apps, and settings can be exported, imported, and synced via iCloud. Menu size, icon size, and selection tolerance are adjustable.
notable: Radial menu that can appear at the screen center or at the mouse cursor
caveats: Page states the app has not yet received enough ratings or reviews to show an overview
